response.overview: In Penápolis, in the countryside of São Paulo, Brazil, settled and landless families share stories of struggle, resistance, and belonging to the land. Through memories, historical records, and diverse voices, *A Margem da Terra* explores the journey of communities shaped by the fight for land reform, family farming, and the search for new possibilities in the countryside. A documentary about memory, territory, and the people who remain on the margins
response.tagline: On the margins of the land, their stories refuse to disappear.
response.title: Documentário - À Margem da terra
